root.label: Epstein Files Transparency Act passed by House

events.label: Epstein Files Transparency Act passed by House

slots.name: House vote tally
slots.sentence: In November, Hinson voted in favor of the bipartisan Epstein Files Transparency Act, a stand-alone bill requiring the Justice Department to release files related to its investigation of Epstein. That bill passed 427-1.

slots.name: legislative status
slots.sentence: Facing increased pressure to release the files, President Donald Trump directed lawmakers to pass the measure requiring the Justice Department to publish online all its files on Epstein.
